verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes conventional human-oriented developer docs: a get-started guide, plus authorisation, rate-limiting and versioning guides for its REST API. Nothing in the pack shows an llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs index. The only probe of llms.txt found a 404 on the parent GOV.UK domain, and the Companies House developer domain itself was not probed, so confidence is medium rather than high.
